claims.claim_text: An official Army row is a probable, not confirmed, match for indexed Ernest J. Bouchea.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army row shares the exact rare name and the seven printed identifier digits after its leading zero, but dates Army entry to November 20, 1945 and records Technician Fifth Grade rather than the index's sergeant text.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable because the rare full name and seven printed identifier digits agree; the leading-zero format, post-OSS-dissolution Army-entry date, and grade difference require personnel-file confirmation.
claims.temporal_assessment: The November 1945 Army-entry record cannot establish a pre-OSS occupation or predecessor affiliation and is used only as qualified identity evidence.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is withheld. Occupation code 065 is not published as a pre-OSS finding because the record is dated after OSS dissolution.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The rare full name and seven printed private-identifier digits agree with an official Army row carrying a leading zero. Its November 20, 1945 Army-entry date and Technician Fifth Grade text differ from the index chronology and sergeant text, so the match remains probable pending Box 71 review.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 71 to confirm the probable Army identity and establish pre-OSS chronology; do not use the November 1945 occupation code as pre-OSS evidence.
